course.title: Django — Complete Practical Backend & REST API Course
course.description: A deep practical Django course covering Python/Django foundations, project architecture, models, ORM, migrations, templates, forms, admin, Django REST Framework, authentication, authorization, security, caching, background jobs, testing, deployment and a complete student learning-platform backend.
learningOutcomes: Build course, enrollment, progress and submission APIs.
Design a production-ready learning platform backend.

lessons.title: Final Capstone: Production Student Learning Platform Backend
lessons.description: Build a production-style Django and Django REST Framework backend for a real student learning platform with course content, authentication, enrollment, progress, tasks, submissions and admin management.

notes.text: Capstone Goal

Build the backend foundation of a realistic education platform. Static course content can come from dedicated JSON files or database models, while student-specific state such as enrollment, progress and submissions is persisted in the database.

notes.caption: Suggested flow: client → Django/DRF URLs → views/viewsets → serializers/services → ORM/database → courses, enrollments, progress, tasks and submissions.
